findings.detail: This device has no direct path to the peer, and hole punching through its rendezvous peer opened one: the peer accepted a connection from this device's own UDP socket, with no relay in between. (host: laptop, rendezvous: hub, candidate: reflexive, family: ipv4)
findings.remedy: Nothing to fix. Commands to this peer start the punch themselves when the direct dial has not stood after one second. `-v` prints the `qsh::punch` lines of each attempt.
